description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_URIFilter' that serves as a base for creating chainable URI filters in the HTMLPurifier library. The class includes properties for filter identification and behavior flags, as well as method signatures for preparation and filtering logic.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter
classes.description: Abstract base class for defining custom URI filters in the HTMLPurifier library. It includes properties to control filter behavior and an abstract method 'filter' to be implemented by subclasses for URI processing.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Performs initialization for the filter, returning false if the filter should not be active.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Abstract method to perform URI filtering and transformation; implemented by subclasses.
